related.title: Alertmanager：群組、抑制與通知去重
related.titleEn: Alertmanager: grouping, inhibition and notification deduplication
related.why:
用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付 aligned-metrics.csv、指標定義與兩個可區辨故障假說。
另一位學徒應能從原始輸入重算結果並重現至少一個反例。
related.whyEn:
Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver aligned-metrics.csv,indicator definitions and two distinguishable hypotheses.
A second learner must reproduce results and at least one counterexample from the original inputs.
related.difference: 逐筆記錄fingerprint與group key；輸入警報仍12個，未抑制服務通知2組，根因通知另外計算。 完成預測、觀察與反例的對照。
related.differenceEn: Record fingerprints and group keys;input alerts remain12,uninhibited service notifications are2 groups,and the root-cause notification is counted separately. Compare prediction,observation and counterexamples.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
基準 6000/60 = 100 requests/s；對照 90/6000*100 = 1.5 percent。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
獨立核對CPU利用率48/60=80%，但錯誤1.5%須按請求計算；以同一時間窗並列三者及queue長度。

基準 3*4 = 12 alerts；對照 3-1 = 2 groups。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
逐筆記錄fingerprint與group key；輸入警報仍12個，未抑制服務通知2組，根因通知另外計算。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Baseline 6000/60 = 100 requests/s; comparison 90/6000*100 = 1.5 percent. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Independently compute CPU utilization80%,but request errors1.5%;align both with rate and queue length over the same window.

Baseline 3*4 = 12 alerts; comparison 3-1 = 2 groups. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Record fingerprints and group keys;input alerts remain12,uninhibited service notifications are2 groups,and the root-cause notification is counted separately.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: OpenAPI：契約演進與相容性矩陣
related.titleEn: OpenAPI: contract evolution and compatibility matrices
related.why:
用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付 aligned-metrics.csv、指標定義與兩個可區辨故障假說。
另一位學徒應能從原始輸入重算結果並重現至少一個反例。
related.whyEn:
Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver aligned-metrics.csv,indicator definitions and two distinguishable hypotheses.
A second learner must reproduce results and at least one counterexample from the original inputs.
related.difference: 建立operationId×scenario矩陣並驗證status與schema；對POST新增required=locale，證明舊請求缺locale被拒絕。 完成預測、觀察與反例的對照。
related.differenceEn: Build an operationId-by-scenario matrix and validate status/schema;add required locale to POST and show old requests fail. Compare prediction,observation and counterexamples.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
基準 6000/60 = 100 requests/s；對照 90/6000*100 = 1.5 percent。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
獨立核對CPU利用率48/60=80%，但錯誤1.5%須按請求計算；以同一時間窗並列三者及queue長度。

基準 4*3 = 12 contract-cases；對照 4*4 = 16 contract-cases。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
建立operationId×scenario矩陣並驗證status與schema；對POST新增required=locale，證明舊請求缺locale被拒絕。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Baseline 6000/60 = 100 requests/s; comparison 90/6000*100 = 1.5 percent. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Independently compute CPU utilization80%,but request errors1.5%;align both with rate and queue length over the same window.

Baseline 4*3 = 12 contract-cases; comparison 4*4 = 16 contract-cases. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Build an operationId-by-scenario matrix and validate status/schema;add required locale to POST and show old requests fail.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
